pasos.prompt: Game prop design of a medieval wine tasting table for the wine cellar of a castle, for an isometric escape room game. A long sturdy rectangular rustic table of thick oak planks on four chunky square legs with a low stretcher bar, grey iron corner brackets with round rivets (same wood, iron and rivets as the reference chest and throne). The table top is completely empty and flat: nothing on it. Chunky simple bold shapes, no carvings, no text. Seen in a three-quarter view slightly from above, whole object visible and centered. Exactly the same stylized 3D toon rendering, soft shading, saturated colors and soft upper-left lighting as the reference images. Edges defined only by light and shading, no outline. Isolated on a flat uniform light grey background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
